topic: How a node verifies a block quickly
hook: Here is how any computer can check a block in moments.

scenes.narration: A node takes the eighty-byte block header and hashes it twice with SHA-256.
It then compares the result with the target. At or below it means the proof of work is valid.
Finding that hash is hard. Checking it is cheap.

cta: Want a deeper dive? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: How a Bitcoin Node Verifies a Block
description_body: Hash the header twice, compare with the target. Finding is hard, checking is cheap.
